entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • APICompat does not catch inconsistent return types of overidden member in multi-targeting library #50914
  • `dotnet add package` inconsistency with file-based apps #50913
  • csc caching for file-based apps doesn't consider non-.cs default items, e.g. *.razor, leading to false cache hits #50912
  • CSC task broken in 10.0.100-rc.2.25467.107: Failed to create CoreCLR, HRESULT: 0x80070008 #50900
  • [NETE2ESDK][Loc] .NET 10.0 RC 2 SDK Installer Shows VS2026 in English version but VS2022 in localized version #50899

Closed

  • [NETSDKE2E]Installing .NET 10 runtime-deps should depend libicu 76 rather than 78 or 77 on Debian 13 #50857
  • Add a new telemetry data point to for if a command was run by an LLM agent #50641
  • [WebToolsE2E] Cannot exceed the range of more than 10 when changing the /weatherforecast in Program.cs #50884
  • MAUI templates do not show up in VS after installing MAUI #49784
  • [NETSDKE2E].NET 10 SDK from VS was not found after uninstalling custom .NET 10 SDK #50546
  • AOT publish doesn't work if PackAsTool is set (a regression) #50435
  • Test failing in CI: Microsoft.DotNet.Tests.PackagedCommandTests.CanInvokeToolWhosePackageNameIsDifferentFromDllName #50892

PullRequests

Created

  • Move HotReloadClients type to shared package, to be used in VS Code. #50911
  • [release/9.0.3xx] Make duplicate deb/rpm packages so we can sign them with the new PMC key #50910
    Branch Lockdown
  • Only run the test templates on x64 #50908
  • Disable package API validation for .NET tools #50907
  • Update Stale GH Action to include PRs #50905
  • Pack file-based apps as tools by default #50904
    Area-run-file
  • Discovery indicator fixes #50903
  • Condition NuGet pack in Microsoft.Net.Sdk on framework only #50902
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50901
  • Set dogfood script working directory #50895

Merged

  • [release/10.0.1xx] backport #50633 - basic LLM detection telemetry #50906
  • Set IsShipping, IsShippingPackage properties for HotReload packages #50909
  • Add LLM environment detection telemetry data point with rule-based detection system and multiple environment support #50663
    consider-for-documentation, Area-Telemetry
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Fix confusing environment option help text in dotnet run command #50894
    Approved to merge
  • Update MSTest templates to latest preview #50831
  • Implicitly set UserSecretsId for file-based apps #50783
    Area-run-file
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50648

Updated

  • Allow SDKs to overwrite default file-based app properties #50885
    Area-run-file, 10.0.1xx
  • File-based apps: consider args in simple csc optimization #50779
    Area-run-file
  • Manually backflow VMR's main #50780
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix dotnet run to accept Windows path separators on Linux #50889
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2796416 #50874
  • Browser tests #50844
    Area-AspNetCore
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'main' #50868
  • add a repo-local telemetry doc and notification for folks that work on CLI Telemetry #50867
    documentation, Area-Telemetry
  • Fixup project reference paths during file-based app conversion #50860
    Area-run-file
  • [StaticWebAssets] Fix recursive glob stem truncation for multi‑dot component JS module files and expand pattern coverage #50863
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Track mono aot in telemetry too #50864
    Document for new feature, Area-Telemetry
  • address Daniel's feedback #50876
